fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the use of the Microsoft signed script "CL_mutexverifiers" to proxy the execution of additional PowerShell script commands
fields.name: Potential Script Proxy Execution Via CL_Mutexverifiers.ps1
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((src.process.image.path contains "\\powershell.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\pwsh.exe") and tgt.process.image.path contains "\\powershell.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -nologo -windowstyle minimized -file ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Windows\\Temp\\")))
